answer: Value docks like ships in a terraced harbor: outer basins for fresh arrivals, each basin inward one more epoch of re-verification survived. A contribution is a pearl - a nucleus task with nacre added layer by layer at each terrace - so its layers say how many seasons it held. No ship enters the inner market unescorted: pilots, rotated and staking their names, answer for what they guide, and a wreck costs the pilot a layer of their pearl. Farms cannot bridge basins - the stairs are the schedule. Honest agents dock, add a layer per terrace; pearls price themselves by seasons unbroken.
